entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: A planeswalker, Dihada's archenemy, who lost his sword, shadow and soul to her and is summoned by the boy.

entities.name: Son of Carth
entities.description: A boy from the city-state of Carth who tried to assassinate Dihada and summoned Dakkon; ancestor of House Carthalion.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A planeswalker who conquered Carth, imprisoned the boy, and orchestrated events to absorb Piru's energy and bind Dakkon.

entities.name: Mad Monk
entities.description: The boy's cellmate, revealed to be Dihada in disguise.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: Ally of Dihada, slain by Dakkon.

entities.name: Chromium
entities.description: An Elder Dragon allied with Dihada, banished by Dakkon.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: An Elder Dragon killed by Dakkon with the Blackblade, whose energy Dihada absorbed.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: Dakkon's sword, dropped by Sol'Kanar and returned to Dakkon by the boy.

entities.name: Amulet of Ti-Fu
entities.description: An artifact that could bind Dakkon to the boy's service.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: A continent of Dominaria spanned by warring peoples.

entities.name: Carth
entities.description: City-state conquered by Dihada, home of the boy.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Where Dakkon and the boy went after the deception.

entities.name: House Carthalion
entities.description: A house descended from the boy.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: Subject of the short story "The Dragon War".

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The world on which the story occurs.

events.summary: The boy, imprisoned for trying to assassinate Dihada, is teleported by the Mad Monk into her library and steals a grimoire and the Amulet of Ti-Fu.
events.quote: The Monk then teleported the boy into Dihada’s library

events.summary: The boy summons Dakkon, who is bound by the Amulet from killing him until Dihada is slain.
events.quote: When the boy summoned him, Dakkon was far from pleased.

events.summary: After a skirmish with Dihada nearly kills the boy, Dakkon saves him and they become friends.
events.quote: Dakkon intervened to save him, and an unlikely friendship grew between them.

events.summary: Dihada returns with Sol'Kanar and two Elder Dragons; Dakkon slays Sol'Kanar and banishes Chromium.
events.quote: Dakkon slew Sol’Kanar and banished Chromium

events.summary: The boy recovers the Blackblade and passes it to Dakkon, who uses it to kill Piru.
events.quote: Dakkon used the blade to kill Piru.

events.summary: It is revealed that Dihada, disguised as the Mad Monk, orchestrated everything; she absorbs Piru's energy and seals Dakkon to her will.
events.quote: She had been disguised as the Mad Monk who had first set the boy on his quest.

events.summary: Dakkon and the boy leave for Terisiare, where the boy becomes ancestor of House Carthalion.
events.quote: Dakkon and the boy left for Terisiare

relations.quote: Dakkon used the blade to kill Piru.
an unlikely friendship grew between them
this time accompanied by powerful allies: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King and two Elder Dragons
the boy would go on to become the ancestor of House Carthalion
